faq.a: Five are built in: UPSC, SSC CGL, IBPS PO, GATE (CS), and CAT, each broken into sections and sub-topics. For example UPSC includes History, Polity, Economy, Science & Tech, Geography, and General sections. You can also pick Custom Syllabus and type your own topics, using the '>' character to nest sub-topics under a section (e.g. 'History > Ancient').

faq.q: How does the revision scheduler decide when a topic is due?
faq.a: If you tick a topic's 'Mark for Revision' box, it uses spaced intervals of 1, 3, 7, and 14 days measured from the date you completed it. A 'Revise!' badge appears on the day a topic falls in one of those windows, and the Revision Due panel lists each marked topic with how many days ago it was completed and its next revision day.

faq.q: Can I log study hours and notes per topic?
faq.a: Yes. The gear icon on each topic opens a modal where you set study hours (in 0.5 steps) and free-text notes, and toggle the revision flag. Hours are summed into a 'Total Study Time' figure, and each section shows a circular percentage ring. A topic with notes shows a 📝 badge and its logged hours appear inline.

faq.q: How do I back up or move my progress?
faq.a: Progress is auto-saved in your browser under the key syl2_<exam>. You can Export Report (a .txt summary), Copy report to clipboard, or Export CSV, which writes a UTF-8 file with a BOM so it opens cleanly in Excel or Google Sheets with columns for Section, Topic, Done, Hours, Revision due, and Notes. Reset progress clears everything for the selected exam after a confirmation.
